Third release candidate for open[flow] 0.1.0, focused on the mix[flow] four-deck mixer and on synced deck timing since RC2.

## Changes since RC2

- Rebuilt the deck fader as a slot and a cap: no well, no plate, a ruled scale, a capped width and a handle that can no longer clip at either end of its travel.
- Stereo metering on every deck, with L/R captions, alongside the master pair.
- Aligned the FX, channel and routing rows on one shared column track, divided by vertical separators, with the routing row sitting under the channel it belongs to.
- Even spacing and one shared width for the launcher, loop and FX controls, replacing columns that stretched to fit their neighbours.
- Quick loop now encloses the playhead instead of jumping to it, which removes the slip on every press that did not land on the grid.
- A synced deck holds its markers to whole beats with Q off: Cue snaps to the beat, and loop In/Out step a beat rather than rounding away to no move at all.
- A caution color role, giving deck Cue its warmth under palettes whose primary is neutral.
- A draggable library rail, remembered across a reload.

## Downloads

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `mix-flow-0.1.0-rc.3-arm64.dmg` | mix[flow]: local stem separation, track preparation and four-deck playback. |
| `set-flow-0.1.0-rc.3-arm64.dmg` | set[flow]: the Ableton Live session manager. |
| `visual-flow-0.1.0-rc.3-arm64.dmg` | visual[flow]: the visual performance app. |
| `SessionBridge-0.1.0-rc.3.zip` | Max for Live bridge for set[flow] and visual[flow]. Keep its three device files together. |

Apple silicon only. The release workflow requires signing, notarization, Gatekeeper and stapled-ticket checks before attaching installers. mix[flow] runs independently of Live and the bridge. Its first separation downloads the managed Python environment, dependencies and model weights. Automatic updates remain disabled; install this version explicitly.

## Before the final release

Test the signed installer on a clean Mac: import, first-run engine setup, cancellation and retry, separation, four-deck playback, and persistence after quitting and reopening. Exercise Cue, quick and manual loops, Slip, beat jumps and synchronization with real tracks, since the timing changes in this candidate affect where markers land on a synced deck. Verify master outputs 1/2 and headphone monitoring on outputs 3/4 with a four-channel interface.

The mixer changes in this candidate were measured in a browser against the running layout and are covered by engine tests; neither replaces clean-machine or hardware testing. Live/device behavior is unverified by this release preparation.

For installation details, see [Installing](https://github.com/ryangavin/better-session-view/wiki/Installing). Include the release version, macOS version, audio hardware and reproduction steps when reporting a problem.
